dct_description_sm:
Brampton Plan Schedule 8 District Energy Area points depicting Urban and Town Centres that will be the focus of efforts to assess opportunities for energy conservation and distribution, including peak demand reduction, resilience to power disruptions, and smaller-scale local energy solutions that incorporate renewable energy, district energy, combined heat and power or energy storage.Subject to further refinement through the completion of future feasibility studies.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
